question: Who among the following does NOT belong to Rampur Sahaswan Gharana?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ustad Fateh Ali Khan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Fateh Ali Khan**, the foremost exponent of Hindustani classical music in Pakistan, is no more. For nearly half a century, he was the patriarch of the** Patiala Gharana** – one of the six native stylistic schools or lineages – of the **Khayal genre of Indian classical music.**
 
• **The Patiala Gharana is one of the vocal gharanas **(tradition, school, or style of music) of Hindustani classical music, named following the city of** Patiala in Punjab, India** where it was established.
 
• Fateh Ali started singing at the **age of nine. The duo of Amanat Ali and Fateh Ali had a glorious singing debut in 1945 in Lahore, sponsored by the influential connoisseur, Pandit Jeevanlal Mattoo.**
 
• Thereafter, both brothers toured South Asia extensively and became representatives of the **Patiala Gharana across the subcontinent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Rashid Khan** is an Indian classical musician in the Hindustani music tradition. He belongs to the Rampur-Sahaswan gharana.
 
• **Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan** was an Indian classical musician in the Hindustani classical music tradition, belonging to the Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana.
 
• Ustad Inayat Hussain Khan (1849–1919) was an Indian classical vocalist, and the founder of Rampur-Sahaswan gharana.
